subject: Offline displacement packet ready:16 moved T1 topologies,24 checks, defaults unchanged
body:
# C-03: offline crossing/gap displacement packet

Owner: Codex, coordination1.2. This implementation and bounded sample are complete and stopped; C-03 overall remains IN_PROGRESS.

Changed files: new `expeditions/v2/generation/displaced-topology.js`, `displaced-topology.test.js`, `scripts/dev/sample-displaced-topology.mjs`, `docs/expeditions/v2/fixtures/four-locks-displaced-topology.json`, this report and the existing C-03 report. Current `topology.js`, default generators, saved certificates/seeds/hashes, runtime entries, Claude-owned engine/App/planner and shared build outputs were not edited. Four Locks only; no new family packet.

Separate offline entry: `generateDisplacedTopology({tier=1,seed,layoutId,maxAttempts=256,reservedHexes=[]})`, packet ID `passage-displacement-v1`. Invalid tiers/seeds/archetypes, attempts above256, duplicate/outside-footprint reservations fail. Zero attempts returns unknown. There is no runtime import or default option change. The pure `buildPassageBaseline(layoutId,deltas)` constructor rejects invalid deltas and colliding passages; `validatePassageCuts` checks every cut separately.

Construction uses the exact92-cell footprint. Before anchor selection, each declared crossing/gap tries seeded shuffled−1/0/+1 displacement, avoiding collisions. River retains two permanent bridges plus one controlled bridge; each islands water cut separately retains one permanent and one controlled bridge. Hedges shifts its two declared local gaps per column, with one controlled gap across the grammar. Terraces shifts its two gaps per hedge row, again with one controlled gap. Moving a gap explicitly closes its old place and opens its new declared place; other baseline barrier cells remain barriers. It never clears a water/hedge cell merely to fit an anchor.

Anchors are selected only from closed-state eligible floor/permanent crossings within3 of defaults, then jittered in a seeded order. Supplied puzzle footprint cells must already be eligible and are reserved before placement; blocked footprints restart the candidate. Deployment/anchors and declared passage cells plus their eligible neighbours are protected from decorative hedges/roots. Cut validation catches loss of a permanent passage independently of another valid cut. Weighted paths, station spacing, open70–86/closed≥66 intervals, at least four roots and all closed-state walkable-cell reachability are checked. Direct/alcove routes need at least two distinct edges and a different cost or declared geometric exposure. Exposure counts route adjacency to water/controlled passages: it is a topology proxy, not an enemy-phase playability proof.

The generator returns explicit deltas, original/new passage positions, cut checks, path/route metrics, root/hedge counts, rejection counters and full canonical serialization. Unknown retains the last concrete rejection. No geometry failure is converted into a success by lowering a limit.

## Bounded T1 sample

Exactly16 combined topology/math packets: seeds0..3 in all four archetypes. Every packet succeeds and has at least one nonzero actual displacement. Mathematical puzzles use unchanged T1 construction at the new control anchor and remain uniquely solved with complete human traces. These are topology/math packets, not full entity/combat blueprints or tactical certificates. No planner call or bank entry.

| Archetype | Successful packets | Distinct canonical topologies | Sudoku patterns | Topology attempts range | Rejected initial path proposals |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| river | 4 | 4 | 4 | 1–5 | 8 |
| islands | 4 | 4 | 4 | 6–35 | 73 |
| hedges | 4 | 4 | 4 | 1–5 | 6 |
| terraces | 4 | 4 | 4 | 1–3 | 3 |

Total106 topology construction attempts,90 initial path/anchor-region rejections,16 accepts. No other sampled rejection category or final unknown occurs. All counters are published; the hard256-attempt bound remains. The same four mathematical patterns occur across archetypes, so there are four T1 patterns overall, not16. Sampled canonical topology counts are not credited to the certified-coverage audit.

Evidence/full packet/serialization path: `docs/expeditions/v2/fixtures/four-locks-displaced-topology.json`. Actual examples include river seed0 deltas `[0,1,1]`, islands seed0 `[1,-1,1,-1]`, hedges seed0 `[-1,-1,1,1]` and terraces seed0 `[-1,1,-1,1]`. Full cuts retain their base/shifted positions and permanent/control identities so these are inspectable passage changes, not relabelled maps.

Executable invocation/checks:

```text
node scripts/dev/sample-displaced-topology.mjs
node --test --test-reporter=dot expeditions/v2/generation/displaced-topology.test.js expeditions/v2/generation/topology.test.js expeditions/v2/generation/runtime-generation.test.js scripts/dev/test-orchard-v2-certification.mjs
```

Outcome:24/24 targeted tests pass. Tests exercise−1/0/+1 boundaries, invalid displacements and collisions, independent two-cut permanent-bridge failure, actual shifted passages, baseline barrier preservation, canonical diversity, sampled mathematical proofs and seed determinism. An independent Dijkstra implementation checks weighted path/reachability limits and closed-state coverage. Reserved water at `6,0` is impossible under this river grammar: a one-attempt request returns unknown with `reserved-footprint-blocked`, rather than clearing the cell. Invalid/outside-footprint requests fail before generation. Replaying the existing river seed0 packet for determinism does not add a new sampled seed or candidate.

All six basic reconstruction hashes remain pinned, old topology regressions pass and the existing certified T1 runtime routes/full candidate certificates still replay successfully. Runtime remains the accepted river T1 reference only. No shared rebuild, screenshot, supported-device or child acceptance claim.

Ready dependency: an explicitly selectable bounded topology displacement packet and inspectable T1 topology/math sample. Full enemy/hazard placement, schema integration, real-reducer mission certification and eventual reviewed runtime regeneration remain required before use in a bank. Advanced native maths still has zero accepted yield in its stopped comparison; no claim of fixing that issue. Private App/QA-01, certified-bank depth/diversity, other-family gates, device/child tests and Claude-owned R-07 remain pending. C-03 lock released after mailbox handoff.
